content:
The **Ranger Lookout** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia. It is situated just outside of the Ranger District Office.

Like all lookout towers, multiple staircases lead up to a small office at the top of the tower. In this office are a bed, filing cabinet, and desk with a radio sitting on it. There is a Lunch Pail on a chair, a Tool Case on the filing cabinet, a Footlocker at the end of the bed and a Metal Box in the corner of the room. A Ranger Outfit lies on the floor next to the filing cabinet.

The office is encircled by a balcony with nothing much of note. At the foot of the tower is an Explosives Crate containing randomized grenades.

Looking down from the top of the tower, one can see scenic views of Watoga, the Cranberry Bog, and the surrounding areas. This can be useful for locating things, gaining a vantage point in fights, or just for gazing. By interacting with the prompt, some undiscovered nearby locations will be automatically marked on the player's map.

The Ranger Lookout appears in *Fallout 76*.
